content: 1. The World Health Organization (WHO) has developed a comprehensive toolkit outlining best practices for injections and related medical procedures. This document was accessed on June 11, 2021, and provides detailed guidance to ensure safety and efficacy in clinical settings. 2. The Vaccine Presentation and Packaging Working Group has created a generic preferred product profile for vaccines. This document, which was accessed on June 21, 2022, outlines standardized recommendations for vaccine design, presentation, and packaging to optimize their use and distribution. 3. The WHO has established a collaborative procedure aimed at accelerating the registration of prequalified finished pharmaceutical products (FPPs). This process is detailed on the WHO Product Streams website and was accessed on November 8, 2021. It is designed to streamline regulatory approvals and facilitate faster access to essential medicines.
